## Harmonic Tune

[![Harmonic Tune — HarmonyCon mascot artwork](https://2025.harmonycon.org/_astro/tune1.DpNXouZc_ZxJCNL.avif)](https://2025.harmonycon.org/)

Harmonic Tune is a colorful, music-themed stallion mascot of the Dallas-area My Little Pony fan convention **HarmonyCon**, frequently paired with fellow mascot **Harmony Star**. His blue-toned coat and sweeping, green-accented multicolored mane make him recognizable in convention artwork. He belongs to *HarmonyCon's own fan-event continuity*, not a verified character in Hasbro's *Friendship Is Magic* television story.

**Name and history:** “Harmonic Tune” is the convention's established name, documented in a May 2019 announcement for the 2020 event; no earlier name or alter ego is verified. This is a convention-authorized name, not a Hasbro television credit. The [2024 convention album credits](https://musicbrainz.org/release/ddccaf83-a8f1-49f0-8b91-720d0ab3a9fb) list Nevaylin for mascot designs on that release, not necessarily for his original creation.

**Speaking and appearances:** No verified TV episode, film, official comic scene, or voice actor. He does have a written in-character greeting on the convention's registration page. His documented appearances are convention branding, merchandise and the HarmonyCon-related *Pony Town* event, rather than G4 show scenes.

**Other image:** [![Harmonic Tune in the 2025 Pony Town event (event sprite; individual artist unverified)](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2025/1/30/3442583/full.gif)](https://twibooru.org/3442583). The official image above is credited to HarmonyCon as publisher; its individual illustrator was not established.

## Important moments

These are documented **convention milestones**, not TV episode scenes. Season/episode numbers do not apply, and verified video timestamps are unavailable.

1. **Mascot returns (2019 announcement for HarmonyCon 2020):** The organizers explicitly named Harmonic Tune alongside Harmony Star as returning mascots, establishing the name in public [convention coverage](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2019/05/harmonycon-confirmed-for-2020.html).
2. **Becomes a plush (HarmonyCon 2024):** An official convention announcement introduced Harmonic Tune, Harmony Star and Clawstin plushies made with Symbiote Studios, giving attendees a physical version of the mascot ([2024 announcement](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2024/01/harmonycon-2024-general-announcement.html)).
3. **Greets visitors (HarmonyCon 2025):** The [official registration page](https://2025.harmonycon.org/register/) gives him the written line “Hey there! What'll it be?”, an identifiable bit of characterization rather than a voiced performance.
